descriptionByLocale.en:
Canton of Zurich Education Directorate Office for Youth and Vocational Advice Center Breitenstein Social Worker/in Adult Protection 60 - 80% The Office for Youth and Vocational Counselling of the Education Directorate provides, appoints, controls and coordinates offers of child and youth welfare and vocational counselling. Zentrum Breitenstein is part of the Office for Youth and Vocational Counselling and is supported and co-financed by the municipalities of the district of Andelfingen. Zentrum Breitenstein provides social services in the areas of child and adult protection, personal assistance, advice and prevention for the population of the district of Andelfingen. The offer is aimed at families, young people, children and adults with special needs, social difficulties and/or addiction problems. Our team will be enlarged – together we can make a difference! The Breitenstein Center in Andelfingen is looking for an experienced and committed social worker for adult protection. Together with your team, you provide adult support for 22 municipalities in the district of Andelfingen, which KESB Winterthur-Andelfingen has arranged. The self-determination and personal responsibility of the clients are always in the foreground. The following tasks await you:
• Management of mandates in accordance with the mandate of KESB, usually with management of income and assets
• Writing of applications and reports to authorities
• Representation in personal, legal and financial matters
• Actively shaping the further development of professional assistance We expect you to:
• Completed studies Social work FH
• Professional experience in adult protection or social assistance
• In-depth knowledge of private law, social security law and social assistance law
• Empathy towards people in difficult life situations
• Psychological resilience and flexibility as well as negotiating-safe performance skills What can you expect from us? You can expect a responsible and interesting activity with scope for independent work. Your workplace is located directly at the Andelfingen station and can be reached in about 40 minutes from Zurich HB. In the administrative area, you will be supported by expert clerks. We follow the KOKES recommendations, attach importance to an appreciative working atmosphere and promote the further training of our employees. The collegial exchange as well as intervisions and supervisions help you to focus your consulting content on the essentials and to act safely even in challenging situations. We look forward to your online application. If you have any questions, Karin Fröhlich, Head of Adult Protection (tel. 043 258 46 50) is at your disposal. www.ajb.zh.ch

• Vertiefte Kenntnisse im Privatrecht, Sozialversicherungsrecht und Sozialhilferecht
• Empathie gegenüber Menschen in schwierigen Lebenssituationen

descriptionByLocale.it:
Cantone di Zurigo Direzione di Giustizia e Affari Interni Juvenile Criminal Law Management Senior Juvenile Lawyer in Co-Management (Topsharing) 70% I cinque avvocati regionali giovani esaminano e valutano i crimini commessi dai giovani tra i dieci e i diciotto anni. Essi effettuano indagini penali e sono responsabili per l'esecuzione delle misure di protezione e sanzioni in base alla legge giovanile. Per la Jugendanwaltschaft See / Oberland siamo alla ricerca di una personalità come un avvocato di gioventù leader / avvocato giovanile leader a stabilire una co-gestione da subito o con accordo. Si prende il controllo della gestione dell'ufficio insieme con l'attuale capo dell'avvocato giovanile. La responsabilità della leadership è esercitata in partenariato. Le decisioni sono formulate in modo coordinato e i compiti sono progettati congiuntamente in base alle competenze e ai requisiti operativi. Questi compiti vi aspettano:
• Responsabilità complessiva: insieme alla cogestione, si assume la gestione organizzativa, tecnica e personale dell'ufficio con circa 19 dipendenti.
• Leader del team: Insieme, si guida un team esperto di avvocati, assistenti sociali e segretari amministrativi e promuovere una cultura di leadership apprezzativa e cooperativa.
• Rappresentanza: Rappresentano l'ufficio insieme e mantengono la cooperazione e il networking con tribunali, autorità e altre organizzazioni partner.
• Attività di gestione e sviluppo: Sei subordinato alla Oberjugendanwaltschaft, partecipare agli organi di gestione del dipartimento di giustizia giovanile e sono coinvolti in progetti cross-divisionali e l'ulteriore sviluppo dell'organizzazione.
• Indagine penale e l'applicazione: Lei lavora anche come avvocato di gioventù o avvocato di gioventù. Conducono indagini penali contro i giovani, rappresentano l'accusa nella corte minorile, emettono ordini penali e, insieme ai lavoratori sociali, accompagnano l'esecuzione di sentenze e decisioni criminali minorili. Questo è ciò che ti distingue:
• Sei un avvocato esperto con molti anni di esperienza professionale in indagini penali e idealmente hanno esperienza nella giustizia penale giovanile o in un campo correlato.
• Essi portano una comprovata esperienza di leadership e hanno il desiderio di leadership in tandem.
• Hanno un alto livello di team e competenze sociali e portare con loro la fiducia e la volontà di prendere decisioni in partenariato e di portarli insieme.
• Sei ulteriormente caratterizzato dalle tue forti competenze comunicative e da un grande interesse per le questioni pedagogiche e socio-politiche.
• Sono disposti a fornire servizi regolari di picket e di marca tour. Vi offriamo: Offriamo un campo di attività significativo, vario e stimolante. I nostri dipendenti beneficiano delle interessanti condizioni di lavoro del Cantone di Zurigo. Applicazione Abbiamo suscitato il vostro interesse? Quindi non vediamo l'ora di completare l'applicazione online. Troviamo il coraggio di sentirsi importante, ma non abbastanza. Ecco perché utilizziamo una valutazione nell'ambito del processo di applicazione. Per ulteriori informazioni, Roland Zurkirchen, Senior Advocate for Youth, o Juliane Meffert, Head of Human Resources, sono disponibili il 043 258 41 70. Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione completa tramite il nostro strumento online.

Canton of Zurich Directorate of Justice and Home Affairs Juvenile Criminal Law Management Senior Juvenile Lawyer in Co-Management (Topsharing) 70% The five regional youth attorneys examine and assess crimes committed by young people between the ages of ten and eighteen. They conduct criminal investigations and are responsible for executing the protection measures and penalties under juvenile law. For the Jugendanwaltschaft See / Oberland we are looking for a personality as a leading youth lawyer / leading youth lawyer to establish a co-management by immediately or by agreement. You take over the management of the office together with the current head of youth lawyer. Leadership responsibility is exercised in partnership. Decisions are made in a coordinated manner and tasks are jointly designed according to competencies and operational requirements. These tasks are waiting for you:
• Overall responsibility: Together with the co-management, you assume the organisational, technical and personnel management of the office with around 19 employees.
• Team leadership: Together, you lead an experienced team of lawyers, social workers and administrative secretaries and promote an appreciative, cooperative leadership culture.
• Representation: They represent the office together and maintain cooperation and networking with courts, authorities and other partner organisations.
• Management and development tasks: You are subordinate to the Oberjugendanwaltschaft, participate in the management bodies of the juvenile justice department and are involved in cross-divisional projects and the further development of the organization.
• Criminal investigation and enforcement: You also work as a youth lawyer or youth lawyer. They conduct criminal investigations against juveniles, represent the prosecution in the juvenile court, issue criminal orders and, together with the social workers, accompany the execution of juvenile criminal judgments and decisions. This is what distinguishes you:
• You are an experienced lawyer with many years of professional experience in criminal investigation and ideally have experience in juvenile criminal justice or in a related field.
• They bring proven leadership experience and have the desire for leadership in tandem.
• They have a high level of team and social skills and bring with them the trust and the will to make decisions in partnership and to carry them together.
• You are further characterized by your strong communicative skills as well as a great interest in pedagogical and socio-political issues.
• They are willing to provide regular picket and brand tour services. We offer you: We offer a meaningful, varied and challenging field of activity. Our employees benefit from the attractive employment conditions of the Canton of Zurich. Application Have we aroused your interest? Then we look forward to your complete online application. We find gut feeling important, but not enough. This is why we use an assessment as part of the application process. For further information, Roland Zurkirchen, Senior Advocate for Youth, or Juliane Meffert, Head of Human Resources, are available on 043 258 41 70. We look forward to your complete application via our online tool.

Sie führen Strafuntersuchungen und sind für den Vollzug der jugendstrafrechtlichen Schutzmassnahmen und Strafen verantwortlich. Für die Jugendanwaltschaft See / Oberland suchen wir zur Etablierung einer Co-Leitung per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine Persönlichkeit als Leitende Jugendanwältin / Leitender Jugendanwalt. Sie übernehmen die Leitung der Amtsstelle gemeinsam mit der heutigen Leitenden Jugendanwältin. Die Führungsverantwortung wird partnerschaftlich wahrgenommen. Entscheidungen werden abgestimmt getroffen und Aufgaben entsprechend den Kompetenzen und betrieblichen Anforderungen gemeinsam gestaltet. Diese Aufgaben warten auf Sie:
• Gesamtverantwortung: Sie übernehmen gemeinsam mit der Co-Leitung die organisatorische, fachliche und personelle Führung der Amtsstelle mit rund 19 Mitarbeitenden.
• Teamführung: Sie führen gemeinsam ein eingespieltes Team aus Juristinnen und Juristen, Sozialarbeiterinnen und Sozialarbeitern sowie Verwaltungssekretärinnen und Verwaltungssekretären und fördern eine wertschätzende, kooperative Führungskultur.
• Vertretung: Sie vertreten die Amtsstelle gemeinsam nach aussen und pflegen die Zusammenarbeit sowie die Vernetzung mit Gerichten, Behörden und weiteren Partnerorganisationen.
• Leitungs- und Entwicklungsaufgaben: Sie sind der Oberjugendanwaltschaft unterstellt, wirken in den Führungsgremien der Jugendstrafrechtspflege mit und engagieren sich in bereichsübergreifenden Projekten und der Weiterentwicklung der Organisation.
• Strafuntersuchung und Vollzug: Sie sind zudem als Jugendanwältin bzw. Jugendanwalt tätig. Sie führen Strafuntersuchungen gegen Jugendliche, vertreten die Anklage vor Jugendgericht, erlassen Strafbefehle und begleiten gemeinsam mit den Sozialarbeitenden den Vollzug jugendstrafrechtlicher Urteile und Entscheide. Das zeichnet Sie aus:
• Sie sind ein/e erfahrene/r Jurist/in mit langjähriger Berufserfahrung in der Strafuntersuchung und verfügen idealerweise über Erfahrung in der Jugendstrafrechtspflege oder in einem verwandten Bereich.
• Sie bringen ausgewiesene Führungserfahrung mit und haben Lust auf Führung im Tandem.
• Sie verfügen über hohe Team- und Sozialkompetenzen und bringen das Vertrauen und den Willen mit, Entscheidungen partnerschaftlich zu fällen und gemeinsam zu tragen.
• Sie zeichnen sich weiter durch Ihre starken kommunikativen Fähigkeiten sowie ein grosses Interesse an pädagogischen und gesellschaftspolitischen Fragen aus.
• Sie sind bereit, regelmässig Pikett- und Brandtourdienst zu leisten. Wir bieten Ihnen: Wir bieten ein sinnstiftendes, abwechslungsreiches und herausforderndes Tätigkeitsgebiet. Unsere Mitarbeitenden profitieren von den attraktiven Anstellungsbedingungen des Kantons Zürich. Bewerbung Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre vollständige Online-Bewerbung. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständige Bewerbung über unser Online-Tool.

Canton of Zurich Directorate of Justice and Home Affairs Prisons and Reintegration Detention Centers Zurich Legal / Secretary / Legal Service 80 - 100% With around 1,400 employees, JuWe is responsible for the execution of penalties and measures as well as for carrying out various types of detention. Our employees from around 40 professions support and promote the reintegration of delinquents and work effectively and progressively for a safe and just society. The Zurich Detention Centers (UGZ) are one of JuWe’s eight main departments, comprising seven companies with approximately 735 prison places and approximately 500 employees. They are responsible for provisional arrest, pre-trial detention and security detention, as well as the premature execution of penalties and measures until transfer to a prison institution. In this way, they fulfil a central function within the Zurich justice system. For the UGZ legal service, we are looking for a motivated, enthusiastic, communication-strong and team-oriented personality. This is your field of action
• Addressing challenging, enforcement issues from the detention centers
• Support and advice to the prison management, the social and health service and the staff in a varied legal field of work with close practical relevance
• Development of decision-making bases and legal basis analyses
• Preparation of opinions on legislative changes
• Processing of complaints and recourses
• Correspondence with procedural lines and defences
• Design and implementation of internal training and information events on relevant legal bases for employees
• Participation in projects and working groups within the UGZ, JuWe or beyond
• Completed degree Master of Law
• Ideally already professional experience in the judicial system and/or in the cantonal administration
• Generalist interest and holistic thinking
• Joy of interdisciplinary cooperation
• Sociability, independence and flexible attitude This is the special thing about this job
• Versatile and demanding work in an interesting, lively and extraordinary environment
• High degree of independence and responsibility
• Working in an exciting and interdisciplinary environment
• Place of work near Altstetten station and in all UGZ operations
• Employment conditions according to cantonal guidelines Your application Take the next step in your professional career with us and send us your application via our online tool. Canton of Zurich Directorate of Justice and Home Affairs Juvenile Criminal Justice Head/Accounting 80 - 100% The juvenile justice department of the Canton of Zurich with its approximately 120 employees examines and assesses the crimes committed by young people between the ages of ten and eighteen. The five regional youth advocacy offices conduct criminal investigations and are responsible for implementing the protection measures and penalties under juvenile law. The Oberjugendanwaltschaft carries the overall responsibility for planning, guiding and controlling the juvenile justice system, provides services for the juvenile advocacy offices and is their supervisory body. Immediately or by agreement, we are looking for a responsible and committed personality as Head of Accounting 80 – 100%. These tasks are waiting for you:
• Professional and personnel management of the 2-3 employees of the central accounting (accountable, debtor and client accounting)
• Ensuring regular, accrual and timely accounting as well as cooperation in interim and annual accounts, budgeting and planning
• Responsibility for uniform financial processes, their documentation and continuous optimization and further development
• Contact person for technical issues and close cooperation with internal and external stakeholders in financially relevant topics
• Collaboration in day-to-day operations if required as well as support and representation in controlling
• Participation in financial projects, in particular in cooperation with the financial directorate and internal offices
• Promotion and further development of employees as well as support for operational accounting in the event of personnel bottlenecks This is what distinguishes you:
• Commercial basic education with further education at the level of Higher School of Applied Sciences (HF) in Finance and Accounting or a Bachelor degree in a comparable subject area
• Several years of professional experience in finance and accounting, preferably in public administration
• Leadership experience
• Very good user knowledge in MS Office and SAP
• Self-employed, prudent and service-oriented working methods as well as high resilience
• Loyalty, confidentiality and a sovereign handling of demanding situations and sensitive dossiers We offer you: We offer a meaningful, varied and challenging field of activity. descriptionByLocale.it:
Cantone di Zurigo Direzione finanziaria Human Resources Project Manager/-in apprendistato sviluppo Amministrazione cantonale 80 - 100% L'Ufficio del Personale del Cantone di Zurigo è responsabile di tutte le questioni di personale, occupazione e sicurezza sociale degli oltre 30.000 dipendenti del Cantone di Zurigo. Il reparto Gestione delle Risorse Umane (HRM) comprende un gran numero di compiti e fa parte dell'Ufficio Risorse Umane. Consulenza delle risorse umane, formazione professionale di base, marchio del datore di lavoro e gestione dei casi sono al centro del lavoro. L'istruzione professionale di base significa plasmare il futuro. Ogni anno, circa cento apprendisti in 25 apprendisti iniziano la loro formazione al Canton Zurigo. Dietro ogni apprendistato c'è l'opportunità di accompagnare i giovani nella loro vita lavorativa e allo stesso tempo di formare gli specialisti di domani. La formazione professionale di base presso l'Ufficio delle Risorse Umane insieme al Forum della formazione professionale è responsabile dell'orientamento strategico e dell'ulteriore sviluppo della formazione professionale nel Cantone di Zurigo - dalla definizione di standard e processi, dall'ulteriore sviluppo dell'offerta di apprendistato, nonché da progetti ed eventi comuni. Insieme, stiamo gettando le basi per il Cantone di Zurigo per espandere ulteriormente il suo ruolo di modello di ruolo nella formazione professionale e continuare a offrire prospettive interessanti per i giovani in futuro. Questa nuova funzione vi offre l'opportunità unica di sviluppare strategicamente la formazione professionale nell'amministrazione cantonale. Insieme sviluppiamo una strategia e concetti cross-direzionali, creiamo nuove prospettive e formiamo la promozione di giovani talenti dal più grande datore di lavoro nel cantone di Zurigo. Il post è limitato in tempo per un progetto fino alla fine del 2029. Come puoi essere coinvolto?
• Sviluppare strategie: Insieme con le direzioni e i dipartimenti, concetti e strategie (ad esempio la promozione dell'apprendistato, l'istituzione del SOG[AB4.1], si crea un ulteriore impiego di apprendisti, modelli di società di insegnamento e professionisti dell'insegnamento) per l'ulteriore sviluppo della formazione professionale nell'amministrazione cantonale.
• I progetti portano al successo: dall'idea alla roadmap all'implementazione, sei responsabile di progetti impegnativi e assicurati che i concetti diventino risultati concreti.
• Costruire reti: Lavori con diversi stakeholder attraverso le directory, consideri interessi diversi, soluzioni attuali
• Creare una base per il processo decisionale: le analisi, le tendenze e le raccomandazioni per l'azione costituiscono la base per le decisioni strategiche e per l'ulteriore sviluppo della formazione professionale.
• Vedrete opportunità per nuovi modelli di formazione, rafforzare le offerte esistenti e sviluppare soluzioni sostenibili in modo che il Cantone di Zurigo offre interessanti prospettive per i giovani in futuro. Chi sei?
• La formazione professionale ti ispira: Conosci la formazione professionale di base dalla tua esperienza professionale e vuoi formarla attivamente.
• Pensa in modo strategico. Realizzazione pratica: sviluppi concetti realizzabili e non perdere mai di vista l'implementazione.
• Collegare le persone: unire interessi diversi e convincere attraverso chiarezza, diplomazia e un aspetto sicuro – anche in un ambiente politico. Cosa ti offriamo?
• Definire il futuro: con il vostro lavoro, sviluppate la formazione professionale del più grande datore di lavoro nel cantone di Zurigo e lasciate un segno duraturo.
• Un sacco di spazio per la manovra: ci si può aspettare una nuova funzione con alta responsabilità personale, attori emozionanti e la possibilità di plasmare attivamente la formazione professionale.
• Condizioni di lavoro moderne: orari di lavoro flessibili, opportunità di ufficio, condizioni di lavoro attraenti e un posto di lavoro a pochi passi dalla stazione centrale di Zurigo offrono condizioni ottimali. E adesso? Abbiamo suscitato il vostro interesse? Allora applica ora. Non vediamo l'ora di incontrarti. Si prega di notare che elaboriamo solo applicazioni che vengono ricevute tramite il nostro strumento online. Non hai bisogno di una lettera di motivazione con noi. Invece, rispondere alle nostre domande nello strumento – così possiamo conoscere voi e la vostra motivazione ancora più specificamente. Per ulteriori informazioni, Florian Manz (Capo dell'istruzione di base professionale) è a vostra disposizione dal 10. Il 1 agosto è disponibile il +41 43 259 42 30. Il tuo nuovo ambiente? www.zh.ch/pa

Canton of Zurich Financial Directorate Human Resources Project Manager/-in apprenticeship development cantonal administration 80 - 100% The Personnel Office of the Canton of Zurich is responsible for all personnel, employment and social security issues of the more than 30,000 employees of the Canton of Zurich. The Human Resources Management (HRM) department includes a large number of tasks and is part of the Human Resources Office. HR consulting, basic vocational training, employer branding and case management are the focus of the work. Basic vocational education means shaping the future. Every year, around one hundred apprentices in 25 apprenticeships start their training at the Canton of Zurich. Behind every apprenticeship there is the opportunity to accompany young people on their way into working life and at the same time to train the specialists of tomorrow. The basic vocational training at the Human Resources Office together with the Vocational Training Forum is responsible for the strategic orientation and further development of vocational training in the Canton of Zurich - from the definition of standards and processes, the further development of the apprenticeship offer as well as joint projects and events. Together, we are laying the foundations for the Canton of Zurich to further expand its role as a role model in vocational training and continue to offer attractive prospects for young people in the future. This newly created function offers you the unique opportunity to strategically develop vocational training in cantonal administration. Together we develop a cross-directional strategy and concepts, create new perspectives and shape the promotion of young talent by the largest employer in the canton of Zurich. The post is limited in time for a project until the end of 2029. How can you get involved?
• Develop strategies: Together with the directorates and departments, concepts and strategies (e.g. apprenticeship promotion, establishment of the SOG[AB4.1], further employment of apprentices, teaching company models and teaching professionals) for the further development of vocational training in the cantonal administration are created.
• Projects lead to success: From the idea to the roadmap to implementation, you are responsible for challenging projects and ensure that concepts become concrete results.
• Build networks: You work with different stakeholders across directorates, consider different interests, present solutions
• Creating a basis for decision-making: Analyses, trends and your recommendations for action form the basis for strategic decisions and the further development of vocational training.
• You will see opportunities for new training models, strengthen existing offers and develop sustainable solutions so that the Canton of Zurich offers attractive prospects for young people in the future. Who are you?
• Vocational training inspires you: You know basic vocational training from your own professional experience and want to actively shape it.
• Think strategically. Practical implementation: You develop viable concepts and never lose sight of the implementation.
• Connect people: You bring different interests together and convince through clarity, diplomacy and a secure appearance – even in a political environment. What do we offer you?
• Shaping the future: With your work, you develop the vocational training of the largest employer in the canton of Zurich and leave a lasting mark.
• Plenty of room for manoeuvre: You can expect a newly created function with high personal responsibility, exciting stakeholders and the opportunity to actively shape vocational training.
• Modern working conditions: Flexible working hours, home office opportunities, attractive employment conditions and a workplace within walking distance to Zurich Central Station offer you optimal conditions. What now? We have aroused your interest? Then apply now. We look forward to meeting you. Please note that we only process applications that are received via our online tool. You do not need a letter of motivation with us. Instead, answer our questions in the tool – so we get to know you and your motivation even more specifically. For further information, Florian Manz (Head of Vocational Basic Education) is available to you from the 10. On 1 August, +41 43 259 42 30 is available. Your new environment? www.zh.ch/pa

Kanton Zürich Finanzdirektion Personalamt Projektleiter/-in Lehrstellenentwicklung kantonale Verwaltung 80 - 100% Das Personalamt des Kantons Zürich ist zuständig für alle personal-, arbeits- und sozialversicherungsrechtlichen Fragen der über 30'000 Mitarbeitenden des Kantons Zürich. Die Abteilung Human Resources Management (HRM) beinhaltet eine grosse Anzahl an Aufgaben und ist Teil des Personalamts. HR-Beratung, Berufliche Grundbildung, Employer Branding und Case Management stehen im Mittelpunkt der Arbeit. Berufliche Grundbildung bedeutet Zukunft gestalten. Jedes Jahr starten rund hundert Lernende in 25 Lehrberufen ihre Ausbildung beim Kanton Zürich. Hinter jeder Lehrstelle steht die Chance, Jugendliche auf ihrem Weg ins Berufsleben zu begleiten und gleichzeitig die Fachkräfte von morgen auszubilden. Die Berufliche Grundbildung im Personalamt ist zusammen mit dem Berufsbildungsforum für die strategische Ausrichtung und Weiterentwicklung der Berufsbildung im Kanton Zürich zuständig - von der Definition von Standards und Prozessen, der Weiterentwicklung des Lehrstellenangebotes sowie gemeinsamen Projekten und Veranstaltungen. Gemeinsam schaffen wir die Grundlagen dafür, dass der Kanton Zürich seine Vorbildrolle in der Berufsbildung weiter ausbaut und auch künftig attraktive Perspektiven für junge Menschen bietet. Diese neu geschaffene Funktion bietet dir die einmalige Möglichkeit, die Berufsbildung in der kantonalen Verwaltung strategisch weiterzuentwickeln. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir eine direktionsübergreifende Strategie und Konzepte, schaffen neue Perspektiven und prägen die Nachwuchsförderung des grössten Arbeitgebers im Kanton Zürich. Die Stelle ist im Rahmen eines Projekts bis Ende 2029 befristet. Wie kannst du dich einbringen?
• Strategien entwickeln: Gemeinsam mit den Direktionen und Fachbereichen entstehen Konzepte und Strategien (u.a. Lehrstellenförderung, Aufbau der SOG, Weiterbeschäftigung von Lehrabgänger/innen, Lehrbetriebsverbundmodelle sowie Lehrberufsverantwortliche) für die Weiterentwicklung der Berufsbildung in der kantonalen Verwaltung.
• Projekte zum Erfolg führen: Von der Idee über die Roadmap bis zur Umsetzung verantwortest du anspruchsvolle Projekte und sorgst dafür, dass aus Konzepten konkrete Ergebnisse werden.
• Netzwerke aufbauen: Du arbeitest direktionsübergreifend mit verschiedenen Anspruchsgruppen zusammen, berücksichtigst unterschiedliche Interessen, präsentierst Lösungsansätze
• Entscheidungsgrundlagen schaffen: Analysen, Trends und deine Handlungsempfehlungen bilden die Basis für strategische Entscheide und die Weiterentwicklung der Berufsbildung.
• Berufsbildung weiterdenken: Du erkennst Chancen für neue Ausbildungsmodelle, stärkst bestehende Angebote und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen, damit der Kanton Zürich auch künftig attraktive Perspektiven für junge Menschen bietet. Wer bist du?
• Berufsbildung begeistert dich: Du kennst die berufliche Grundbildung aus eigener beruflicher Erfahrung und möchtest sie aktiv mitgestalten.
• Strategisch denken. Praktisch umsetzen: Du entwickelst tragfähige Konzepte und verlierst dabei nie die Umsetzung aus den Augen.
• Menschen verbinden: Unterschiedliche Interessen bringst du zusammen und überzeugst durch Klarheit, Diplomatie und ein sicheres Auftreten – auch in einem politischen Umfeld. Was bieten wir dir?
• Zukunft gestalten: Mit deiner Arbeit entwickelst du die Berufsbildung des grössten Arbeitgebers im Kanton Zürich weiter und hinterlässt nachhaltige Spuren.
• Viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Dich erwartet eine neu geschaffene Funktion mit hoher Eigenverantwortung, spannenden Stakeholdern und der Möglichkeit, die Berufsbildung aktiv mitzugestalten.
• Moderne Arbeitsbedingungen: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten, attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und ein Arbeitsplatz in Gehdistanz zum Zürcher Hauptbahnhof bieten dir optimale Rahmenbedingungen. Für weitere Auskünfte steht dir Florian Manz (Leiter Berufliche Grundbildung) ab dem 10. August unter +41 43 259 42 30 gerne zur Verfügung. Dein neues Umfeld? www.zh.ch/pa

Canton de Zurich Direction financière Ressources humaines Chef de projet/-en apprentissage Administration cantonale 80 - 100% L'Office du personnel du canton de Zurich est responsable de l'ensemble du personnel, de l'emploi et de la sécurité sociale des plus de 30 000 employés du canton de Zurich. Le Département de la gestion des ressources humaines comprend un grand nombre de tâches et fait partie du Bureau des ressources humaines. La consultation en ressources humaines, la formation professionnelle de base, l'image de marque de l'employeur et la gestion des cas sont au cœur du travail. L'enseignement professionnel de base signifie façonner l'avenir. Chaque année, une centaine d'apprentis en 25 apprentissages commencent leur formation au canton de Zurich. Derrière chaque apprentissage il y a l'occasion d'accompagner les jeunes sur leur chemin vers la vie active et en même temps de former les spécialistes de demain. La formation professionnelle de base de l'Office des ressources humaines et du Forum de la formation professionnelle est responsable de l'orientation stratégique et du développement de la formation professionnelle dans le canton de Zurich - de la définition des normes et des processus, du développement de l'offre d'apprentissage ainsi que des projets et événements communs. Ensemble, nous jetons les bases pour que le canton de Zurich élargisse encore son rôle de modèle dans la formation professionnelle et continue d'offrir des perspectives intéressantes aux jeunes à l'avenir. Cette nouvelle fonction vous offre l'occasion unique de développer stratégiquement la formation professionnelle dans l'administration cantonale. Ensemble, nous développons une stratégie et des concepts transdirectionnels, créons de nouvelles perspectives et façonnons la promotion des jeunes talents par le plus grand employeur du canton de Zurich. Le poste est limité dans le temps pour un projet jusqu'à la fin de 2029. Comment peux-tu t'impliquer ?
• Développer des stratégies: En collaboration avec les directions et départements, des concepts et des stratégies (par exemple promotion de l'apprentissage, mise en place du SOG[AB4.1], poursuite de l'emploi d'apprentis, modèles d'entreprises d'enseignement et professionnels de l'enseignement) pour le développement de la formation professionnelle dans l'administration cantonale sont créés.
• Les projets mènent à la réussite : de l'idée à la feuille de route jusqu'à la mise en œuvre, vous êtes responsable des projets difficiles et vous assurez que les concepts deviennent des résultats concrets.
• Construire des réseaux : Vous travaillez avec différents intervenants à travers les directions, considérez différents intérêts, présentez des solutions

Canton of Zurich Directorate of Justice and Home Affairs Prisons and Reintegration Investigation Prisons Zurich Supervisor/in / Supervisor/in 80 - 100% Prison and Reintegration (JuWe) is responsible as part of the Directorate of Justice and Home Affairs of the Canton of Zurich for the execution of penalties and measures as well as the execution of the various types of detention. For our 1,400 employees from around 40 professions, the successful social reintegration of people who have committed crimes and the prevention of recidivism are of particular importance. The Zurich Prisons of Detention (UGZ) – one of eight main departments of JuWe – currently operates seven prisons for pre-trial and security detention. Around 300 employees look after more than 700 detainees. The Horgen prison offers 51 seats and is run as a department of the Limmattal prison. To complement our team in Horgen Prison, we are looking for a committed, cosmopolitan and humorous personality by immediate or by agreement. Your tasks
• You will accompany, assist and employ detained persons during their pre-trial detention from entry to exit, taking on tasks in care, security and organisation
• You will meet imprisoned people and visitors professionally, respectfully and in a situational manner and act clearly and de-escalatingly even in demanding situations.
• You ensure an orderly daily routine, enforce safety and service regulations and manage crisis situations carefully
• Test at headquarters You ensure the safety of employees, detainees and third parties by operating security, surveillance and communications facilities as well as by triggering the security facility in emergencies
• You coordinate and supervise the visitation, receive gifts and ensure the necessary controls, including X-ray controls
• You take on administrative tasks such as reports and documentation and support the administration within the framework of detachment agencies, in particular dossier management, correspondence and the management of detainee accounts Your profile
• Meet people in a forced context You have a professional attitude, regulated proximity and distance, and the ability to detect crisis situations early and act de-escalating.
• You are motivated to actively participate in the development and design of prison conditions
• You are psychologically resilient and flexible for shift, night, weekend and holiday services
• You have technical understanding and pleasure in dealing with safety-relevant systems
• Completed commercial training (EFZ) or comparable and several years of professional experience, preferably in a comparable job
• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing; Knowledge of foreign languages is advantageous
• Able to deal with MS Office
• Minimum age of 25 years and an impeccable reputation (no relevant entries in the penal or enforcement register) Our offer
• A demanding, versatile job in a dynamic work environment with a supportive team
• Careful familiarization as well as diverse internal and external further training possibilities, e.g. B. the part-time training as a specialist for the administration of justice with eidg. Specialist card
• A centrally located place of work with good connections to public transport
• Attractive employment conditions according to cantonal guidelines We are pleased about applicants with a lot of initiative, openness, humour and joy in working in a dynamic company. Take the next step in your career with us and send us your application via our online tool. We look forward to your dossier! Do you have questions? Vuoi diventare parte del motore economico Svizzera e modellare il tuo futuro professionale in un ambiente di lavoro versatile e moderno? Allora siete esattamente al Cantone di Zurigo. Circa 300 apprendisti completano la loro formazione in 25 diverse professioni. Nella sola formazione professionale delle TIC, circa 70 giovani stanno attualmente imparando e plasmando attivamente il futuro digitale del Cantone. Come mediamatista EFZ o mediamatista EFZ, combina creatività, comunicazione e tecnologia. La vostra formazione inizia con un anno di base di apprendistato, in cui si acquisiscono le basi tecniche più importanti. Imparerai a progettare, produrre e pubblicare testi, immagini, video, contenuti audio e media digitali secondo il gruppo target. A te
• Compiti includono la progettazione di media digitali e stampati, la creazione di contenuti per siti web e social media, e il lavoro su progetti nei settori della comunicazione, marketing, design e multimedialità. Utilizzi strumenti e tecnologie moderne e sviluppi soluzioni creative per diversi gruppi target. The
• Frequenti la scuola secondaria A e ottieni prestazioni costantemente buone, soprattutto in matematica e nelle lingue tedesche e straniere. Inoltre, ti piace lavorare in una squadra, comunicare in modo sicuro e godere di trattare con le persone. descriptionByLocale.en:
Canton of Zurich Financial Directorate Personnel Office Apprenticeship as Mediamatist/-in EFZ 2027 100% Shape the digital future with us! Do you want to become part of the economic engine Switzerland and shape your professional future in a versatile and modern working environment? Then you are exactly right at the Canton of Zurich. Around 300 apprentices complete their training in 25 different professions. In ICT vocational training alone, around 70 young people are currently learning and actively shaping the digital future of the canton. As a mediamatist EFZ or mediamatist EFZ, you combine creativity, communication and technology. Your training starts with a basic apprenticeship year, in which you acquire the most important technical foundations. You will learn to design, produce and publish texts, images, videos, audio content and digital media according to the target group. To your
• Tasks include designing digital and printed media, creating content for websites and social media, and working on projects in the areas of communication, marketing, design and multimedia. You use modern tools and technologies and develop creative solutions for different target groups. The
• You attend secondary school A and achieve consistently good performance, especially in mathematics as well as in German and foreign languages. You are creative, interested in digital media and new technologies and have a quick apprehension and logical thinking ability. In addition, you like to work in a team, communicate safely and enjoy dealing with people. If you are looking for a varied education where you can combine creativity, communication and technology, we look forward to your online application. We are looking forward to meeting you and accompanying you on your way to the Mediamatist or the Mediamatist EFZ. A complete application includes the following documents: - CV - Letter of Application - All school certificates of the secondary school - Interlock test and/or multicheck questions? For information about the job, please contact the team Vocational Basic Education at Tel. +41 43 259 33 15. The Canton of Zurich on social media TikTok Instagram LinkedIn zh.ch/learning

Rund 300 Lernende absolvieren bei uns ihre Ausbildung in 25 verschiedenen Berufen. Allein in der ICT-Berufsbildung lernen derzeit rund 70 Jugendliche und gestalten die digitale Zukunft des Kantons aktiv mit. Du lernst Texte, Bilder, Videos, Audioinhalte und digitale Medien zielgruppengerecht zu gestalten, zu produzieren und zu veröffentlichen. Zu deinen
• Aufgaben gehören die Gestaltung digitaler und gedruckter Medien, die Erstellung von Inhalten für Websites und Social Media sowie die Mitarbeit an Projekten in den Bereichen Kommunikation, Marketing, Design und Multimedia. descriptionByLocale.it:
Cantone di Zurigo Direzione Affari Economici Ufficio per gli Affari Economici Specialista / in area di permessi di lavoro 60 - 70% Nell'interesse di aziende e dipendenti, l'Ufficio per gli Affari Economici (AWI) sta aiutando a rafforzare Zurigo come luogo. L'AWI raggruppa competenze economiche nei settori della promozione della posizione, dei permessi di lavoro, delle relazioni di lavoro, dell'ispettorato del lavoro e dell'economia. A livello cantonale, l'area dei permessi di lavoro garantisce l'attuazione delle disposizioni legali relative all'ammissione degli stranieri al lavoro. A partire dal 01.10.2026 o d'accordo, contiamo sul vostro sostegno come avvocato specializzato / permesso di lavoro. I loro compiti:
• Elaborazione di complesse richieste e richieste
• Partecipazione alla garanzia della qualità e allo sviluppo nel settore dei permessi di lavoro
• Co-sviluppo delle pratiche di esecuzione, nonché l'orientamento e l'ulteriore sviluppo dei permessi di lavoro come membro del team di gestione
• Responsabilità delle procedure di ricorso relative ai permessi di lavoro e alla gestione indipendente dei casi pertinenti
• Rete e cooperazione con altri uffici, in particolare l'Ufficio cantonale di migrazione e la Segreteria di Stato per la migrazione (SEM)
• Consultare e sostenere l'area (soprattutto la gestione dell'area) negli affari politici e chiarimenti legali
• Responsabilità del processo per la documentazione e l'archiviazione del tuo profilo:
• Studi legali completi
• Almeno tre anni di esperienza professionale qualificata come avvocato – idealmente in amministrazione pubblica o in un ambiente amministrativo (brevetto di avvocato rilevante)
• Adaptness e sicurezza nella formulazione strutturata di opinioni e decisioni complesse, nonché interesse per questioni economiche e procedurali
• Molto buone competenze in inglese a livello C1
• l'assertività e l'aspetto convincente verso diversi contatti da business e amministrazione Offriamo:
• Attività interessante e stimolante all'interfaccia di business e amministrazione
• Luogo di lavoro a pochi minuti a piedi dalla stazione centrale di Zurigo
• Contributo ai costi della ristorazione (controllo di soggiorno)
• Prestazioni sociali ben sviluppate secondo la legge cantonale del personale Fai il passo successivo nella tua carriera professionale con noi e inviaci la tua applicazione tramite il nostro strumento online. Non vediamo l'ora del tuo dossier! Ancora domande? Andreas Luchsinger e Corinne Mastroberardino (attuale titolare del lavoro, +41 43 259 26 14) sono felici di rispondere a domande circa la funzione. Per questa posizione, non consideriamo le domande sulle società di servizio del personale.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Canton of Zurich Directorate of Economic Affairs Office for Economic Affairs Specialist lawyer/in area of employment permits 60 - 70% In the interest of companies and employees, the Office for Economic Affairs (AWI) is helping to strengthen Zurich as a location. The AWI bundles economic competences in the areas of location promotion, work permits, employment relations, labour inspectorate and economics. At cantonal level, the area of work permits ensures the implementation of the legal provisions concerning the admission of foreigners to work. As of 01.10.2026 or by agreement, we count on your support as a specialist lawyer / work permit. Their tasks:
• Processing of complex requests and requests
• Participation in quality assurance and development in the field of work permits
• Co-development of enforcement practice as well as the orientation and further development of work permits as a member of the management team
• Responsibility for appeal proceedings concerning work permits and independent handling of relevant cases
• Networking and cooperation with other offices, in particular the Cantonal Migration Office and the State Secretariat for Migration (SEM)
• Advising and supporting the area (especially the area management) in political affairs and legal clarifications
• Process responsibility for documentation and archiving your profile:
• Completed legal studies
• At least three years of qualified professional experience as a lawyer – ideally in public administration or in an administrative environment (advantageous lawyer patent)
• Adaptness and security in the structured formulation of complex opinions and decisions as well as interest in economic and procedural issues
• Very good English skills at level C1
• assertiveness and convincing appearance towards different contacts from business and administration We offer:
• Interesting and challenging task at the interface of business and administration
• Place of work a few minutes walk from Zurich Central Station
• Contribution to catering costs (lunch check)
• Well-developed social benefits according to cantonal personnel law Take the next step in your professional career with us and send us your application via our online tool. We look forward to your dossier! Still questions? Andreas Luchsinger and Corinne Mastroberardino (current job holder, +41 43 259 26 14) are happy to answer questions about the function. For this position, we do not consider applications about personnel service companies.

Kanton Zürich Volkswirtschaftsdirektion Amt für Wirtschaft Fachjurist/in Bereich Arbeitsbewilligungen 60 - 70% Im Interesse von Unternehmen und Arbeitnehmenden trägt das Amt für Wirtschaft (AWI) dazu bei, den Standort Zürich zu stärken. Im AWI sind die wirtschaftlichen Kompetenzen in den Bereichen Standortförderung, Arbeitsbewilligungen, Arbeitsbeziehungen, Arbeitsinspektorat und Volkswirtschaft gebündelt. Der Bereich Arbeitsbewilligungen sorgt auf kantonaler Ebene für den Vollzug der gesetzlichen Bestimmungen betreffend Zulassung von Ausländerinnen und Ausländern zur Erwerbstätigkeit. Per 01.10.2026 oder nach Vereinbarung zählen wir auf Ihre Unterstützung als Fachjurist/in Arbeitsbewilligungen. Ihre Aufgaben:
• Bearbeitung von Anfragen und Gesuchen mit komplexem Sachverhalt
• Mitwirkung bei der Qualitätssicherung und –entwicklung im Bereich Arbeitsbewilligungen
• Mitgestaltung der Vollzugspraxis sowie der Ausrichtung und Weiterentwicklung des Bereichs Arbeitsbewilligungen als Mitglied des Leitungsteams
• Verantwortung für Rechtsmittelverfahren, die den Bereich Arbeitsbewilligungen betreffen und eigenständige Bearbeitung entsprechender Fälle
• Vernetzung und Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Amtsstellen, insb. dem Kantonalen Migrationsamt und dem Staatssekretariat für Migration (SEM)
• Beratung und Begleitung des Bereichs (insb. der Bereichsleitung) bei politischen Geschäften und rechtlichen Abklärungen
• Prozessverantwortung für Dokumentation und Archivierung Ihr Profil:
• Abgeschlossenes juristisches Studium
• Mindestens drei Jahre qualifizierte Berufserfahrung als Jurist/in – idealerweise in der öffentlichen Verwaltung oder im verwaltungsnahen Umfeld (Anwaltspatent von Vorteil)
• Gewandtheit und Sicherheit in der strukturierten Formulierung von komplexen Stellungnahmen und Entscheiden sowie Interesse an wirtschaftlichen und verfahrensrechtlichen Fragestellungen
• Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse auf Niveau C1
• Durchsetzungsvermögen und überzeugender Auftritt gegenüber unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern aus Wirtschaft und Verwaltung Wir bieten:
• Interessante und anspruchsvolle Aufgabe an der Schnittstelle von Wirtschaft und Verwaltung
• Arbeitsort wenige Gehminuten vom Hauptbahnhof Zürich
• Beitrag an die Verpflegungskosten (Lunch-Check)
• gut ausgebaute Sozialleistungen nach kantonalem Personalrecht Machen Sie mit uns den nächsten Schritt in Ihrer beruflichen Laufbahn und schicken Sie uns Ihre Bewerbung über unser Online-Tool. Wir freuen uns auf Ihr Dossier! Noch Fragen? Gerne sind Andreas Luchsinger und Corinne Mastroberardino (aktuelle Stelleninhaberin, +41 43 259 26 14) für Fragen zur Funktion für Sie da. Für diese Stelle berücksichtigen wir keine Bewerbungen über Personaldienstleistungsunternehmen.

La Scuola cantonale Rychenberg Winterthur è una scuola lunga con profili di vecchia e moderna lingua e il profilo PPP, un corso di scuola bilingue tedesco / inglese e una scuola specializzata con i profili Pedagogia e comunicazione e informazioni. Con 1250 studenti, 275 dei quali frequentano FMS, KRW è una delle scuole più grandi del cantone. Ulteriori informazioni sono disponibili sul nostro sito web (www.krw.ch ). La nostra offerta
• ruolo di leadership versatile nelle aree pedagogiche, del personale, amministrative e finanziarie con grandi opportunità di progettazione in un ambiente dinamico
• team di gestione scolastica e docenti ben funzionante e di mentalità aperta

• personalità comunicativa e responsabile del team con un aspetto sovrano, ben versato nel trattare con studenti, genitori, insegnanti e dipendenti nell'amministrazione e nelle operazioni
• Elevate prestazioni, resistenza, talento organizzativo e capacità di leadership
• Conoscenza dell'offerta didattica delle scuole secondarie di Zurigo
• studi universitari completati, diploma di insegnamento per le scuole di maturità, esperienza di insegnamento a livello secondario in un argomento rilasciato a KRW
• Certificato come principale o la volontà di acquisire una delle vostre attività

• well-functioning, open-minded school management team and teaching staff
• Living school culture with a diverse offer

Canton of Zurich Directorate of Justice and Interior Prison Imprisonment and Reintegration Prison Pöschwies Springerin / Springer, temporary 80 - 100% Prison Imprisonment and Reintegration (JuWe) is responsible as part of the Directorate of Justice and Interior of the Canton of Zurich for the execution of penalties and measures as well as the execution of the various types of detention. For our 1,400 employees from around 40 professions, the successful social reintegration of people who have committed crimes and the prevention of recidivism are of particular importance. The Pöschwies Prison (JVA) Pöschwies is one of eight main departments of JuWe and, with 399 seats, the largest closed JVA in Switzerland for delinquent men. It fulfils a central state task and, in accordance with the legal mandate, takes into account the rehabilitation of detained persons and the protection of the general public. In the field of economics and work, we are looking for a flexible, resilient and eager-to-learn personality with pronounced social competence and interest in the prison system. The term of office shall be two years. Your tasks
• Support of our work masters in versatile and varied activities in the work facilities
• Assuming responsible safety, control and oversight tasks and ensuring the smooth operation of operations
• Assistance and guidance of detained persons in various workplaces with the aim of promoting their personal and professional skills
• Provision of work materials and quality controls to ensure careful and timely execution of work
• Creating a safe and structured environment for detainees, staff and external partners
• Active teamwork and co-responsibility for safety within the context of emergency management Your profile
• Completed basic technical and craft training and several years of professional experience in this field
• Ideally, you will bring experience in managing employees or supervising learners
• Very good German language skills in word and writing as well as sound IT user skills are required; Foreign language skills are a plus
• With a quick comprehension and a high willingness to learn, you will quickly familiarize yourself with new tasks
• You convince with team spirit, resilience and flexibility and keep an overview even in demanding situations
• A minimum age of 25 years and a perfect reputation round off your profile Our offer
• You can expect an exciting and versatile job in an exceptional working environment
• Benefit from attractive internal and external training opportunities for your professional and personal development
• You can expect regular working hours from Monday to Friday in the uniformed office, which enable good planning of everyday life.
• Food facilities directly on site in the JVA restaurant

• Contemporary and attractive employment conditions according to the cantonal guidelines Your application Ready for a new challenge? Cantone di Zurigo Direzione Finanziaria Enterprise Architetto per soluzioni fiscali digitali 100% Benvenuti nell'affascinante mondo delle tasse! Insieme agli uffici fiscali comunali, l'ufficio tributario cantonale raccoglie le tasse per la Confederazione, il Cantone e i Comuni. Sosteniamo le persone e le imprese durante tutto il processo di raccolta fiscale. Circa 800 dipendenti qualificati sono impegnati a questo presso il sito Altstetten di Zurigo. Con il progetto "Joint IT 2032", l'ufficio tributario cantonale sta creando un panorama IT moderno e uniforme per la tassazione del cantone e dei 160 comuni. Per i nostri 1.400 dipendenti, la riuscita reintegrazione sociale di persone che hanno commesso crimini e la prevenzione della recidiva sono di particolare importanza. La prigione di Pöschwies (JVA) è uno degli otto reparti principali del JuWe. Con 399 posti a sedere, il JVA Pöschwies è il più grande carcere chiuso in Svizzera per gli uomini. Esegue un compito centrale dello Stato e, in conformità con il mandato giuridico, tiene conto della riabilitazione delle persone detenute e della protezione del pubblico generale. L'attuazione è un passo fondamentale nella transizione verso la libertà. Essi consentono alle persone incarcerate di assumersi gradualmente la responsabilità e di testarsi nella vita quotidiana al di fuori dell'istituzione. In questo modo, essi danno un importante contributo alla riabilitazione sociale, alla stabilizzazione e all'integrazione sociale. Per questa impegnativa funzione specialistica, stiamo cercando due personalità con esperienza (60 - 80% ciascuno) che condividono la responsabilità. In stretta collaborazione, si valutano questioni complesse, fanno valutazioni ben fondate e si sostengono a vicenda in scambio professionale. I tuoi compiti
• Valutazione indipendente delle domande di congedo e uscite nel carcere chiuso e aperto del JVA Pöschwies
• Preparazione di opinioni ben fondate e comprensibili sui rischi di volo, generale e di ricaduta come base per il processo decisionale per le autorità di gestione e di istruire
• Preparazione strutturata, precisa e indirizzabile di problematiche complesse
• Garantire il rispetto degli obblighi e delle condizioni di easing garantito
• Una stretta cooperazione con i servizi sociali, la gestione e le autorità esterne nell'ambito della pianificazione dell'attuazione
• Partecipazione all'ulteriore sviluppo delle norme professionali e sostegno alla formazione delle persone accompagnate nel settore del congedo e dell'uscita
• Scambio professionale continuo con il secondo professionista per valutare congiuntamente casi complessi e garantire un processo decisionale uniforme
• Formazione professionale completa o istruzione superiore, preferibilmente nel settore commerciale o sociale
• Almeno 10 anni di esperienza professionale in un ambiente amministrativo, sociale, di sicurezza o normativo esigente
• Esperienza nella gestione strutturata di casi complessi, nonché la capacità di comporre report, valutazioni e riassunti sonori in modo sicuro, preciso e indirizzabile
• Gestione sicura delle apparecchiature di lavoro digitali e delle applicazioni di MS Office comuni, nonché la digitalizzazione nella lavorazione quotidiana
• Alta discrezione, professionalità e una reputazione impeccabile (nessuna voce nell'esecuzione o nel registro penale) La nostra offerta

Canton of Zurich Directorate of Justice and Interior Prison Implementation and Reintegration Pöschwies Senior Specialist/in Implementation Easings 60 - 80% Prison Implementation and Reintegration (JuWe) is responsible as part of the Directorate of Justice and Interior of the Canton of Zurich for the execution of penalties and measures as well as the implementation of the various types of detention. For our 1,400 employees, the successful social reintegration of people who have committed crimes and the prevention of recidivism are of particular importance. The Pöschwies Prison (JVA) is one of eight main departments of the JuWe. With 399 seats, the JVA Pöschwies is the largest closed prison in Switzerland for men. It performs a central state task and, in accordance with the legal mandate, takes into account the rehabilitation of detained persons and the protection of the general public. Implementation easing is a key step in the transition back to freedom. They enable incarcerated persons to gradually assume responsibility and to test themselves in everyday life outside the institution. In this way, they make an important contribution to social rehabilitation, stabilization and social integration. For this demanding specialist function, we are looking for two experienced personalities (60 - 80% each) who share responsibility. In close cooperation, you assess complex questions, make well-founded assessments and support each other in professional exchange. Your tasks
• Independent assessment of applications for leave and exits in the closed and open prison of the JVA Pöschwies
• Preparation of well-founded and comprehensible opinions on flight, general and relapse risks as a basis for decision-making for the management and instructing authorities
• Structured, precise and addressable preparation of complex issues
• Ensuring compliance with obligations and conditions of granted easing of enforcement
• Close cooperation with the social service, management and external authorities in the context of implementation planning
• Participation in the further development of professional standards and support for training of accompanying persons in the area of leave and exit
• Continuous professional exchange with the second professional to jointly assess complex cases and ensure uniform decision-making
• Completed vocational training or higher education, preferably in the commercial or social sector
• At least 10 years of professional experience in a demanding administrative, social, security or regulatory environment
• Experience in the structured handling of complex cases as well as the ability to compose sound reports, assessments and summaries in a style-confident, precise and addressable manner
• Safe handling of digital work equipment and the common MS Office applications as well as enjoying actively shaping digitalization in everyday work
• High discretion, professionalism and an impeccable reputation (no entries in the enforcement or criminal record) Our offer
• Versatile and demanding work with high personal responsibility
• Shared responsibility and close cooperation with a second professional as an integral part of the function
• Meaningful task with varied challenges as well as diverse training opportunities
• Careful and comprehensive training by the current job holder
• Easily accessible place of work with optimal connection to public transport and available parking spaces
• Attractive employment conditions according to cantonal guidelines Your application Are you ready for a responsible task with effect? Then we look forward to your application via our online tool. Für unsere 1'400 Mitarbeitenden sind die erfolgreiche soziale Wiedereingliederung von straffällig gewordenen Menschen und die Verhinderung von Rückfällen von besonderer Bedeutung. Die Justizvollzugsanstalt Pöschwies (JVA) ist eine von acht Hauptabteilungen des JuWe. Die JVA Pöschwies ist mit 399 Plätzen die grösste geschlossene Justizvollzugsanstalt der Schweiz für Männer. Sie erfüllt eine zentrale staatliche Aufgabe und trägt gemäss gesetzlichem Auftrag der Resozialisierung der inhaftierten Personen und dem Schutz der Allgemeinheit Rechnung. Vollzugslockerungen sind ein zentraler Schritt im Übergang zurück in die Freiheit. Sie ermöglichen inhaftierten Personen, schrittweise Verantwortung zu übernehmen und sich im Alltag ausserhalb der Anstalt zu erproben. Damit leisten sie einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Resozialisierung, Stabilisierung und sozialen Integration. In enger Zusammenarbeit beurteilt ihr komplexe Fragestellungen, trefft fundierte Einschätzungen und unterstützt euch gegenseitig im fachlichen Austausch. Deine Aufgaben
• Selbstständige Beurteilung von Gesuchen zu Urlauben und Ausgängen im geschlossenen sowie offenen Vollzug der JVA Pöschwies
• Erarbeitung fundierter und nachvollziehbarer Stellungnahmen zu Flucht-, Gemein- und Rückfallrisiken als Entscheidungsgrundlage für die Direktion und einweisende Behörden
• Strukturierte, präzise und adressatengerechte Aufbereitung komplexer Sachverhalte

Canton of Zurich Directorate of Justice and Home Affairs Prison and Reintegration Med. Practical assistant 80 - 100% Imprisonment and Reintegration (JuWe), as part of the Directorate of Justice and Home Affairs of the Canton of Zurich, is responsible for the execution of penalties and measures as well as the implementation of the various types of detention. For our 1,400 employees from around 40 professions, the successful social reintegration of people who have committed crimes and the prevention of recidivism are of particular importance. As part of the Zurich Prisons of Detention (UGZ), Winterthur Prison (GFW) assumes central tasks in the area of detention without judgment. In questo stage, si lavora all'interfaccia di costruzione, BIM, dati, IT e l'organizzazione per garantire che BIM non solo funziona su carta. For our 1,400 employees from around 40 professions, the successful social reintegration of people who have become guilty of criminal offences, the prevention of relapses, and the detention and preparation of the departure of persons without valid residence permits are of particular importance. The Bachtel prison centre (VZB) is one of the enforcement facilities of the canton of Zurich (VEZ) – one of seven main departments of the JuWe – and is an institution specialized in the open execution of imprisonment and replacement sentences. To strengthen the support and security service, we are looking for a flexible personality by immediately or by appointment. Tasks - Accompanying and caring for detained persons to prevent damage to their detention - Maintaining order and security for the detained persons, employees and third parties - Maintaining the health of the detained persons and accompanying them to external offices - Operation of the security centre and monitoring of the locking systems (inside and outside) as well as operation of the telephone control centre with overview and reliability - Reception of visitors and carrying out gift, effects and X-ray checks as well as trustful care of inmates and visitors, including the recognition and management of crisis situations - Careful completion of administrative tasks to support smooth operation - Interdisciplinary, cross-sectoral cooperation with employees working for the enforcement center Third parties

Kanton Zürich Direktion der Justiz und des Innern Justizvollzug und Wiedereingliederung Vollzugseinrichtungen Zürich Mitarbeiter/in Betreuungs- und Sicherheitsdienst 80 - 100% Justizvollzug und Wiedereingliederung (JuWe) ist als Teil der Direktion der Justiz und des Innern des Kantons Zürich für den Straf- und Massnahmenvollzug sowie die Durchführung verschiedener Haftarten verantwortlich. Für unsere 1'400 Mitarbeitenden aus rund 40 Berufen sind die erfolgreiche soziale Wiedereingliederung von straffällig gewordenen Menschen, die Verhinderung von Rückfällen sowie die Festhaltung und Vorbereitung der Ausreise von Personen ohne gültigen Aufenthaltstitel von besonderer Bedeutung. Das Vollzugszentrum Bachtel (VZB) gehört zu den Vollzugseinrichtungen des Kantons Zürich (VEZ) – eine von sieben Hauptabteilungen des JuWe – und ist eine auf den offenen Vollzug von Freiheits- und Ersatzfreiheitsstrafen spezialisierte Institution. Das VZB bietet Platz für über 90 inhaftierte Personen. Zur Verstärkung des Betreuungs- und Sicherheitsdienstes suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine flexible Persönlichkeit. Deine Aufgaben
• Begleiten und Betreuen von inhaftierten Personen zur Verhinderung von Haftschäden
• Aufrechterhalten von Ordnung und Sicherheit für die inhaftierten Personen, Mitarbeitende und Drittpersonen
• Aufrechterhalten der Gesundheit der inhaftierten Personen sowie Begleitung an externe Stellen
• Bedienung der Sicherheitszentrale und Überwachung der Schliessanlagen (innen und aussen) sowie Bedienung der Telefonzentrale mit Überblick und Zuverlässigkeit
• Empfang von Besuchenden sowie Durchführung von Gaben-, Effekten- und Röntgenkontrollen sowie eine vertrauensvolle Betreuung von Insassen und Besuchenden, inklusive dem Erkennen und Bewältigen von Krisensituationen
• Sorgfältige Erledigung administrativer Aufgaben zur Unterstützung eines reibungslosen Betriebs
• Interdisziplinäre, bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit mit Mitarbeitenden für das Vollzugszentrum tätigen Drittpersonen Dein Profil
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung mit eidg. Fähigkeitszeugnis, (Fach-)Maturität, Fachmittelschulausweis oder gleichwertigem Abschluss; idealerweise ergänzt durch mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer betreuungsnahen Funktion
• Professioneller Umgang mit Nähe und Distanz im Kontakt mit Inhaftierten; hohe Sozialkompetenz sowie ausgeprägte Durchsetzungsfähigkeit
• Du bist in einer guten körperlichen Verfassung, psychisch belastbar und wechselnde Arbeitszeiten (Schicht-, Nacht-, Wochenend- und Feiertagsdienste) sind mit Deinen anderen Verpflichtungen vereinbar
• Du kannst Dich schriftlich und mündlich in Deutsch sehr gut ausdrücken und verfügst über Kenntnisse in weiteren Sprachen. Den Umgang mit der MS-Office-Palette beherrschst Du
• Du bist mindestens 25 Jahre alt und verfügst über einen einwandfreien Leumund (keine Einträge im Strafregister und im Betreibungsregister)
• Offenheit bei personellen Engpässen auch bereichsübergreifende Einsätze in anderen Abteilungen des VZB zu leisten Wir bieten Dir
• Eine spannende und vielseitige Aufgabe mit Verantwortung in einem besonderen Arbeitsumfeld
• Eine strukturierte und sorgfältige Einarbeitung in Deine neue Tätigkeit
• Einen attraktiven Arbeitsort im schönen Zürcher Oberland
• Faire und transparente Anstellungsbedingungen gemäss den kantonalen Richtlinien Deine Bewerbung Mach mit uns Deinen nächsten beruflichen Entwicklungsschritt und schick uns Deine Bewerbung über unser Online-Tool. Wir freuen uns auf Dein Dossier! Noch Fragen zur Tätigkeit? Gerne sind Philipp Turke, Teamleiter BSD und Stv. Bereichsleiter Betreuung und Sicherheit oder Joël Zürcher, Bereichsleiter Betreuung und Sicherheit unter 043 258 14 00 für Dich da. descriptionByLocale.fr: Description Canton de Zurich Direction de la justice et des affaires intérieures Institutions chargées de l'exécution de la justice et de la réintégration Zurich Service de soutien et de sécurité du personnel 80 - 100% Justice et réintégration (JuWe) est responsable de l'exécution des peines et des mesures dans le cadre de la Direction de la justice et des affaires intérieures du canton de Zurich et de l'exécution de divers types de détention. Le centre pénitentiaire de Bachtel (VZB) est l'un des centres d'exécution du canton de Zurich (VEZ) – l'un des sept principaux départements du JuWe – et est une institution spécialisée dans l'exécution ouverte des peines de prison et de remplacement. Pour renforcer le service de soutien et de sécurité, nous recherchons une personnalité flexible immédiatement ou sur rendez-vous. Tâches - Accompagner et soigner les personnes détenues pour éviter qu'elles ne soient endommagées - Maintien de l'ordre et de la sécurité des personnes détenues, des employés et des tiers - Maintien de la santé des personnes détenues et les accompagner dans des bureaux extérieurs - Fonctionnement du centre de sécurité et surveillance des systèmes de verrouillage (intérieur et extérieur) ainsi que de l'exploitation du centre de contrôle téléphonique avec vue d'ensemble et fiabilité - Réception des visiteurs et réalisation de contrôles des dons, des effets et des rayons X ainsi que des soins de confiance des détenus et les visiteurs, y compris la reconnaissance et la gestion des situations de crise - Achèvement minutieux des tâches administratives pour favoriser un fonctionnement sans heurt - Coopération interdisciplinaire et intersectorielle avec les employés travaillant pour le centre d'application de la loi. Certificat Aptitude, (spécial) maturité, certificat d'études secondaires ou équivalent; idéalement complété par plusieurs années d'expérience dans une fonction proche des soins - Traitement professionnel de la proximité et de la distance en contact avec les détenus; haute compétence sociale et forte affirmation - Vous êtes en bon état physique, mentalement résistant et changement d'heures de travail (équipe, nuit, week-end et services de vacances) sont compatibles avec vos autres obligations - Vous pouvez vous exprimer très bien dans l'écriture et verbalement en allemand et ont sur la connaissance dans d'autres langues. Garantisce cure e cure mediche complete e promuove la salute della popolazione zurighese.
• Stiamo cercando uno specialista 80-90% in permessi aziendali per il reparto di approvazione e supervisione presso l'Ufficio della salute di immediatamente o per accordo. Compiti - Lavorerai su domande complete e complesse per l'approvazione e l'approvazione da parte di varie istituzioni sanitarie come ospedali, ospedali o pratiche mediche. - Potrai anche contribuire a supervisionare gli operatori sanitari e le istituzioni sanitarie, tra l'altro, accompagnando le ispezioni in loco. - Lavorerai a stretto contatto con il Dipartimento Legale e Cantonale. Description Canton of Zurich Health Directorate Office of Health Specialist in company permits, 80 - 90% The Canton of Zurich Office of Health provides high-quality and economically viable healthcare in the canton of Zurich. It ensures complete medical treatment and care and promotes the health of the Zurich population. We are looking for an 80-90% specialist in company permits for the approvals & supervision department in the Office of Health by immediately or by agreement. Tasks - You will work on comprehensive and complex applications for approval and approval from various healthcare institutions such as hospitals, hospitals or medical practices. - You will also help to supervise health professionals and health institutions by, among other things, accompanying on-site inspections. - You will work closely with the Legal and Cantonal Department.
• Profile - We are looking for an initiative and a high-performance person who has gained several years of current professional experience as a long-term care professional (care home or Spitex). - In addition, you will have experience in the design of the service schedule and personnel planning, ideally complemented by knowledge of the RAI system (Resident Assessment Instrument). - You have a strong understanding of the Swiss health system and its education system and have a degree at tertiary level (A or B). - Ideally, you also have commercial experience. - Your strengths include a safe appearance and skill in oral and written communication. - You have a fast understanding, think connected and can tackle complex issues in a structured, solution-oriented and targeted manner. - You are being certified for an analytical, goal-oriented, efficient and structured way of working. - You are trustworthy and ready to provide an above-average service for our customers. Kanton Zürich Gesundheitsdirektion Amt für Gesundheit Fachspezialist/-in Betriebsbewilligungen, 80 - 90% Das Amt für Gesundheit des Kantons Zürich sorgt für eine hochstehende und wirtschaftlich tragbare Gesundheitsversorgung im Kanton Zürich. Es stellt eine lückenlose medizinische Behandlung und Betreuung sicher und fördert die Gesundheit der Zürcher Bevölkerung. Für die Abteilung Bewilligungen & Aufsicht im Amt für Gesundheit suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n Fachspezialist/-in Betriebsbewilligungen, 80-90% .
• Aufgaben Sie bearbeiten umfassende und komplexe Bewilligungs- und Zulassungsgesuche von verschiedenen Institutionen aus dem Gesundheitswesen wie beispielsweise Heime, Spitäler oder Arztpraxen. Zudem helfen Sie bei der Aufsicht über Gesundheitsfachpersonen und Gesundheitsinstitutionen mit, indem sie unter anderem Inspektionen vor Ort begleiten. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit der Abteilung Recht und dem Kantonsärztlichen Dienst zusammen. Profil Wir suchen eine initiative und leistungsbereite Persönlichkeit, die mehrjährige aktuelle Berufserfahrung als Pflegefachperson im Langzeitbereich (Pflegeheim oder Spitex) gesammelt hat. Zudem bringen Sie Erfahrung in der Dienstplangestaltung sowie der Personalplanung mit, idealerweise ergänzt durch Kenntnisse im Umgang mit dem RAI-System (Resident Assessment Instrument).Sie haben ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens sowie seines Bildungssystems und verfügen über einen Abschluss auf Tertiärstufe (A oder B). Idealerweise bringen Sie auch kaufmännische Berufserfahrung mit. Zu Ihren Stärken zählen ein sicheres Auftreten und Geschick in der mündlichen und schriftlichen Kommunikation. Sie haben eine rasche Auffassungsgabe, denken vernetzt und können komplexe Sachverhalte strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und zielgerichtet angehen. Ihnen wird eine analytische, zielorientierte, effiziente und strukturierte Arbeitsweise attestiert. Sie sind vertrauenswürdig und bereit, für unsere Kunden eine überdurchschnittliche Leistung zu erbringen. Angebot

Insieme a voi, come dipartimento di amministrazione digitale della Cancelleria di Stato, stiamo guidando la trasformazione digitale del Cantone di Zurigo in avanti. L'intelligenza artificiale (AI) offre un grande potenziale per sostenere efficacemente l'amministrazione e fornire i suoi servizi alla popolazione e alle aziende in modo efficiente, sicuro e appropriato. L'uso di AI può alleviare i dipendenti, semplificare i processi e aumentare la qualità dei servizi. Allo stesso tempo, sono necessarie chiare condizioni quadro, affidabilità e gestione responsabile dei dati, della sicurezza e delle questioni etiche. Nell'amministrazione e in particolare nell'Ufficio Informatica, nell'Ufficio Statistica e Dati, nell'Ufficio delle Risorse Umane e nel settore dell'amministrazione digitale, promuoviamo quindi l'uso sicuro, responsabile e a valore aggiunto dell'IA. Un componente importante è i servizi AI di base che forniscono ai dipendenti un supporto concreto nel lavoro quotidiano, ad esempio nelle trascrizioni, nell'elaborazione delle parole o nelle soluzioni chatbot. Sei pronto a sfruttare il potenziale dell'IA nel Cantone di Zurigo e quindi guidare la trasformazione digitale del Cantone di Zurigo? • Sei responsabile per i servizi di base AI durante tutto il loro ciclo di vita all'interfaccia di utenti, business e tecnologia. In particolare, questo significa:
• L'utente assume la responsabilità dell'applicazione tecnica, definisce gli obiettivi del prodotto, i requisiti, i criteri di successo e controlla ulteriori sviluppi dei servizi di base AI.
• È possibile controllare i partner di sviluppo interni ed esterni professionalmente e garantire la connettività per applicazioni specialistiche, nuovi casi di utilizzo e funzionalità.
• Gestisci il portafoglio di servizi AI di base in tutto il ciclo di vita, tra cui sinergie, dipendenze, funzionamento continuo, sostituzione, decommissione e valutazione regolare di benefici, redditività e soluzioni alternative.

• Lei guida progetti per lo sviluppo e il trasferimento operativo dei servizi di base AI. Il tuo profilo
• Si porta una laurea completa o master in informatica aziendale, business, scienza dei dati, intelligenza artificiale o un programma di laurea comparabile.

Aiutate a plasmare la trasformazione digitale dell'amministrazione e contribuire al beneficio per la popolazione e l'economia, che è al centro di tutte le nostre attività. Canton of Zurich State Chancellery Digital Administration Product Owner/in AI Basic Services 80 - 100% Are you ready to actively shape the future of the Canton of Zurich? Together with you, as the Digital Administration department of the State Chancellery, we are driving the digital transformation of the Canton of Zurich forward. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers great potential to support the administration effectively and to provide its services to the population and companies efficiently, securely and appropriately. The use of AI can relieve employees, simplify processes and increase the quality of services. At the same time, clear framework conditions, reliability and responsible handling of data, security and ethical issues are required. In administration and in particular in the Office for Informatics, the Office for Statistics and Data, the Human Resources Office and in the field of digital administration, we therefore promote the safe, responsible and value-adding use of AI. An important component is basic AI services that provide employees with concrete support in everyday work, for example in transcriptions, word processing or chatbot solutions. Are you ready to harness the potential of AI in the Canton of Zurich and thus drive the digital transformation of the Canton of Zurich? In the area of digital administration, we are looking for a product owner/in AI basic services by September or by agreement. Your tasks
• You are responsible for the AI basic services throughout their entire life cycle at the interface of users, business and technology. Specifically, this means:
• You assume technical application responsibility, define product goals, requirements, success criteria and control further developments of the AI basic services.
• You control internal and external development partners professionally and ensure connectivity for specialist applications, new use cases and features.
• You manage the portfolio of basic AI services throughout the entire life cycle, including synergies, dependencies, continued operation, replacement, decommissioning and regular evaluation of benefits, profitability and alternative solutions.

An interesting and diverse task awaits you in an interdisciplinary environment in which you come into contact with a wide range of internal positions. Zusammen mit dir treiben wir als Bereich Digitale Verwaltung der Staatskanzlei die digitale Transformation des Kantons Zürich voran. Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) bietet grosses Potenzial, um die Verwaltung wirksam zu unterstützen und ihre Leistungen gegenüber der Bevölkerung und Unternehmen effizient, sicher und adressatengerecht zu erbringen. Gleichzeitig braucht es klare Rahmenbedingungen, Verlässlichkeit und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Daten, Sicherheit und ethischen Fragen. In der Verwaltung und insbesondere im Amt für Informatik, im Amt für Statistik und Daten, im Personalamt und im Bereich Digitale Verwaltung fördern wir deshalb den sicheren, verantwortungsvollen und mehrwertstiftenden Einsatz von KI. Bist du bereit, das Potenzial von KI im Kanton Zürich nutzbar zu machen und damit die digitale Transformation des Kantons Zürich voranzutreiben?
